FLAC demuxer (FlacReader) and muxer (encodeFlacStream).

Demuxer ports symphonia-bundle-flac (demuxer.rs, parser.rs minus the streaming fragment machinery): fLaC marker, metadata blocks (StreamInfo required, VorbisComment tags, others skipped by length), frame indexing with header-CRC8 + footer-CRC16 verification, seek by binary search. Deviation: the reference parses packets on demand from a seekable stream; this reader is in-memory and builds an exact frame index on open, which makes seek trivial and integrity fail-closed.

The muxer (encodeFlacStream) is new work: StreamInfo + minimal VorbisComment + frames from encodeFlacFrame.
